items.text: At the regional gastroenterology central intake, will a lean redesign of intake rework followed by a structured referral template reduce returned referrals from 22 percent to 10 percent or less and the median time from receipt to triage decision from nine to five working days by June 2027, without raising template bypass above 25 percent?
items.population: Adult gastroenterology referrals from 160 family practices
items.intervention: Returned-referral queue, fixed daily triage time, then the structured template with a documented test exception
items.comparator: Twelve-week baseline of the current process
items.outcome: Weekly proportion of returned referrals and median time to triage decision
items.time: Twelve baseline weeks, then January to June 2027

finer: Feasible with the lean coach and existing data; interesting to practices and the intake; novel in its combination; ethical as service improvement; relevant because the template goes live in 2027 either way.
summary: One time-bound improvement aim with a balancing limit.
